speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your postpartum check-up. To help me understand your condition, please tell me exactly how long it has been since you gave birth and what your fever temperature is. Additionally, where exactly is the most painful area of your abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Urinary retention secondary to prolonged labor and analgesia, leading to postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness.
